title: checkout.session.async_payment_failed is unhandled — a failed delayed payment leaves the row pending with no audit, notification, or deterministic transition
detail: The new state machine settles PendingPayment via checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded but has no arm for its documented failure twin, checkout.session.async_payment_failed (Stripe: 'You might also want to listen for and handle checkout.session.async_payment_failed'). It hits the silent unknown arm: unclaimed, unlogged, no fail_payment, no PaymentFailed audit, no notification. Reachable for pre-deploy in-flight async sessions the diff itself acknowledges (idempotency-tag rationale). Row stays pending until a later, unconnected session-expiry flips it to failed — silently.
recommended_fix: Add an async_payment_failed arm that runs fail_payment by session id + PaymentFailed audit (same machinery as handle_checkout_failed), acking 200; the landlord then sees 'failed' and can retry.

title: 100%-off promo redemption completes with payment_status="no_payment_required" — the gate strands the order permanently: no settle/fail/expired event will ever fire
detail: Sessions set allow_promotion_codes=true (stripe_client.gleam:177), and the code's own contract documents 100% promos: 'ZERO is a valid settled amount: checkout enables allow_promotion_codes, and a 100% promotion code settles the session at amount_total: 0'. Stripe fires completed with payment_status="no_payment_required" and no PaymentIntent for free orders; no async settle/fail or expired event ever follows. Gate claims the event, row stuck pending forever, vacancy locked forever, no audit, no recovery — pre-deploy this order completed at amount_cents=0 and unlocked.
recommended_fix: Treat "no_payment_required" as a valid completion (amount_total 0): run the completed machinery for it so free promo orders unlock, keeping "processing"/"unpaid"/missing on the pending path.
